tagline.en: ByteDance's Bernini-R renderer at 14B — an Apache-2.0 model for higher-fidelity image and video generation with reference-guided modes.
tagline.zh: 字节跳动 Bernini-R 渲染器的 14B 版本——Apache-2.0 许可,面向更高保真度的图像与视频生成,支持参考条件模式。

en: Bernini-R is the renderer of ByteDance's Bernini family, published on Hugging Face under Apache-2.0 in a Diffusers-compatible format. This 14B variant is the larger renderer in the family, trading heavier hardware for higher-fidelity output.

A single model covers a broad task set: text-to-image and image-to-image for stills, text-to-video and video-to-video for motion, and reference-to-video plus reference-video-to-video, where a reference image or clip steers the generated result. Image tasks run on a single GPU, while video tasks can spread across multiple GPUs using Ulysses sequence parallelism.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — pick the checkpoint and task, supply a prompt (and an image, video, or reference where the task calls for it), and it renders the output.
zh: Bernini-R 是字节跳动 Bernini 系列的渲染(生成)模型,以 Diffusers 兼容格式、Apache-2.0 许可发布在 Hugging Face 上。这个 14B 变体是家族中更大的渲染器,以更重的硬件开销换取更高的输出保真度。
一个模型覆盖多种任务:文生图与图生图用于静态图像,文生视频与视频到视频用于动态画面,还有参考到视频与参考视频到视频——用一张参考图或一段参考片段来引导结果。图像任务可在单卡运行,视频任务则可借助 Ulysses 序列并行分布到多张 GPU 上。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它:选好 checkpoint 与任务,给出提示词(以及任务需要的图像、视频或参考素材),它便渲染出结果。

whenToUse.en: When you want an openly-licensed renderer that spans image and video generation — including reference-guided video — and can afford the larger 14B for higher fidelity, optionally scaling video across multiple GPUs.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可、覆盖图像与视频生成(含参考引导视频)的渲染器,并且能承受更大的 14B 以换取更高保真度、必要时把视频任务扩展到多张 GPU 时。

notFor.en: When hardware is tight, the 1.3B renderer is the lighter option. Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 当硬件受限时,1.3B 渲染器是更轻量的选择。Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: One model for text/image-to-image and text/video/reference-to-video
Video tasks scale across GPUs with Ulysses sequence parallelism
zh: 一个模型覆盖文/图生图与文本/视频/参考条件的视频生成
支持参考条件的图像与视频生成
视频任务可用 Ulysses 序列并行扩展到多张 GPU
